title: Creating 3D Game Art
author: Theobane
selftext:
Hey all!

Looking for some advice! I am building a game using Codex and Claude with Unity, I have GitHub also working with them.

Codex: Graphic assets 

Claude: Coding

I am planning to replace all assets down the line with custom or something designed by an artist, but for the moment I want to have a decent enough graphic assets for the game. I filmed a location where the game is based (in a forest valley in Ireland) and I have asked Codex to convert and use the images and video footage, but so far using Sol 6.1 it's doing a not great job at making the assets.

Anyone have any advice or recommendations in improving the assets that it produces?

Thank you in advance!
